_: THE PINNED CONTENT REPO'S ZONE INVENTORY, enumerated rather than counted.
Two corpora of grammar programs exist and they have different owners. The
RULE LIBRARY lives in this repo (`library::PROGRAMS`), so its size is a fact
of this tree and a zero there is a hard red. The CAMPAIGN corpus lives in the
content repo, and an in-progress campaign lives on its own development branch
and reaches content `main` only after the owner has played it. So this repo
can see a campaign's zone programs only once they are on `main` and
`versions.toml` `[content].sha` has moved to carry them — and until then a
sweep over the campaign corpus honestly examines nothing.
'Nothing was found, so pass' is an opt-out the defect supplies: deleting every
zone program of every campaign produces exactly that state. This file is the
different demand. It NAMES the campaigns the pin carries and how many zone
programs each is expected to declare, so a campaign that loses its programs
reds on a count, while a pin that genuinely carries none passes with its
inventory printed.
WHICH LIST AN ENTRY BELONGS TO IS DECIDED BY THE PINNED TREE, NEVER BY THE
AUTHOR. `on_pin` entries must be present in the pinned checkout; `off_pin`
entries must be ABSENT from it. Moving an entry across to dodge a count reds
immediately, which is what keeps the two lists from being a choice.
`content_sha` must equal `versions.toml` `[content].sha`. That is what binds
this file to the event it guards: a re-pin cannot land without the inventory
being restated at the new pin, and a restated inventory is checked against
the tree, so writing a number the tree disagrees with is a red rather than a
shortcut.
`off_pin` is a queue, not an exemption. It records what a campaign owes and
where that obligation is discharged today, so that when the pin moves the
reviewer has the number to check. Nothing in this repo can verify a content
branch; the content repo's own `zone-audit.yml` runs the same sweep there.

off_pin.note: The remake in progress. Its eight zone programs are the artifact of record for its geometry and they are gated on that branch by the content repo's zone-audit workflow. They become this repo's obligation at the re-pin that follows the owner's acceptance, at which point this entry moves to on_pin and its count is checked against the tree.

on_pin.note: A prefab-and-jigsaw campaign. Its geometry comes from the .nbt library, not from the grammar back end, so it declares no zone program.
Predates the grammar back end (ADR-0018); its world is authored as prefabs and world edits, so it declares no zone program.
